opening.argument: The presentation promotes paid participation through packages priced as high as 5,000 euros and characterizes the associated tokens as permission to mine OneCoin. Its earnings model extends through four generations or levels and links that structure to weekly matching-bonus income, including a claimed 620 euros per week from a thirty-person example. The projected bonuses, prices, and future exchange access are promotional predictions rather than established outcomes. A visible disclaimer qualifies the figures as predictions, and the records do not establish actual trading, payouts, or realized losses.
